request: Create a skill for our weekly purchase-order exception report. I will supply a report date and rows with poId, supplier, expectedDate, orderedQuantity and receivedQuantity. Flag a row only when expectedDate is before the report date and receivedQuantity is less than orderedQuantity. Report PO, supplier, remaining quantity and calendar days overdue, sorted by days overdue descending. If a row has invalid dates or negative quantities, list it separately as needing correction. We do not want the skill to email anyone or update purchase orders.

targetCapabilities.providedInput: Text or structured rows in the user request
